parameters.name: AgeGt
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the age is older than 14. Valid values:
- **T**: older than 14
- **F**: younger than 14

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds. Example: 1760630399999.

parameters.name: ServiceCode
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:
- **antcloudauth**: financial-grade ID Verification.
- **cloudauthst** (discontinued): ID Verification - Enhanced Edition.
- **cloudauth** (discontinued): ID Verification.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds. Example: 1760025600000.
